name: Tripod cauldron (li) with strap handle
summary: Tripod cooking vessel raised on three pouched, hollow, conical legs and with wide, indented neck, and broad strap handle attached from rim to the top of one leg; deeply textured markings on the legs and the bulging sides; decorated with two small bosses at the top of the handle and larger bosses at the top of the two other legs; light gray earthenware with cord-impressed and applique decoration. Longshan culture, Keshengzhuang II culture; from the middle Yellow River region, probably Shaanxi pro
